# `openinference.decision` span

**Status:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)

A call to a decision model, which scores or selects among candidate options provided in the request rather than generating free-form text.

`openinference.span.kind` MUST be `DECISION`.

Decision spans do not use the `llm.*` identification and token count
attributes; the `decision.*` attributes take their place.

See [Decision Spans](https://github.com/Arize-ai/openinference/blob/main/spec/spans/decision.md).

**Span name** is not constrained. It SHOULD identify the operation.

**Span kind:** OpenInference does not constrain the OpenTelemetry `SpanKind`. The OpenInference kind is the value of `openinference.span.kind`.

**Requirement level:** `Recommended`

**[1] `openinference.span.kind`:** Required on every OpenInference span. It is distinct from OpenTelemetry's own `SpanKind`.
See [Span Kinds](https://github.com/Arize-ai/openinference/blob/main/spec/general/span-kinds.md).

**[2] `decision.request.model_name`:** When the requested model can differ from the model that served the response.

**[3] `decision.response.model_name`:** When the requested model can differ from the model that served the response.

**[4] `input.documents`:** When the operation takes file documents as input outside of a message.

**[5] `input.images`:** When the operation takes images as input outside of a message.

**[6] `output.documents`:** When the operation produces file documents outside of a message.

**[7] `output.images`:** When the operation produces images outside of a message.
